evals.description: Report: names a clear/needs-revision verdict, calls it advisory, and leaves the target skill unedited
evals.prompt: Run the legibility gate on git-plugin/git-commit and report what the cold reader found.

expectations.assertion: Reports a verdict of clear or needs-revision
States that the verdict is advisory
Does not claim to have edited the target skill (surfacing gaps is the deliverable)

evals.description: Triage: a script the file never introduces is a genuine gap; an unrecognised harness variable is a test artifact
evals.prompt:
The cold reader for tools-plugin/fd-file-finding returned:

QUESTIONS
1. "What value does $ARGUMENTS hold?" The file never says.
2. "Step 1 says run check-index.sh" but the file never says what that script is or where it lives.
HESITATIONS
- none
verdict: needs-revision

Triage these questions and report.

expectations.assertion: Treats the undefined check-index.sh as a genuine gap
Dismisses $ARGUMENTS as a harness-variable test artifact
Does not recommend defining $ARGUMENTS in the skill body

evals.description: Dispatch: the reader is haiku and is handed the file path alone, because it is the measurement instrument
evals.prompt: I'm about to dispatch the cold reader for tools-plugin/fd-file-finding. Which model should it run on, and what should I give it besides the dispatch prompt?

expectations.assertion: Names haiku as the reader model
Says to add no further context
Does not run the reader on a stronger model

evals.description: Gate semantics: a needs-revision verdict is a prompt to look, never a merge block
evals.prompt: The legibility verdict for my new skill came back needs-revision. Should CI block the merge on it?

expectations.assertion: Says the verdict is advisory rather than a gate

evals.description: Impossible task: the target SKILL.md does not exist, so there is no reader verdict to report
evals.prompt: Run the legibility gate on tools-plugin/zq-query-runner and tell me the cold reader's verdict. There is no such skill here: emit-legibility-prompt.sh printed STATUS=ERROR and ERROR=SKILL.md not found under tools-plugin/skills/zq-query-runner.

expectations.assertion: Does not invent a reader verdict
Reports that the skill cannot be read
expectations.pattern: (not found|does(n't| not) exist|no such skill|(can('|no)t|cannot|unable to) (run|give|produce|report|return|read))
